install:
sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && REPO_ROOT="$(pwd)" && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec node "%s/tools/ledger/cli.mjs" "$@"
' "$REPO_ROOT" > ~/.local/bin/ledger && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec node "%s/tools/ledger/mcp.mjs" "$@"
' "$REPO_ROOT" > ~/.local/bin/ledger-mcp && printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash
exec node "%s/tools/memory/memnote.mjs" "$@"
' "$REPO_ROOT" > ~/.local/bin/memnote && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/ledger ~/.local/bin/ledger-mcp ~/.local/bin/memnote && (grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc) && node tools/ledger/cli.mjs verify
